description: Check whether a library may be shipped inside a client project. Reads the repository's licence file and returns the detected SPDX id, the repository, the sha256 of that file, the check date and a safe_for_commercial_delivery flag. A library whose licence could not be read comes back as unverified — never assume it is permissive. Call this before delivering code that contains a third-party library.

library.description: Library id, e.g. aceternity, icons-lucide, shadcn, magicui.

name: check_licence
